sources.source_english:
Artifact creatures you control get +2/+0.
When Borg Queen enters, assimilate target creature card from an opponent's graveyard. (Put it onto the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter. It's a Borg artifact creature and loses all other creature types.)
sources.source_chinese: 由你操控的神器生物得+2/+0。\n当博格女王进场时，从任一对手的坟墓场同化目标生物牌。（将它在你的操控下放进战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。它是博格人神器生物，并失去所有其他生物类别。）

sources.source_english:
When this enchantment enters, target opponent may have you draw a card. If they don't, they lose 4 life and you surveil 1.
Whenever you face a dilemma, you may return this enchantment to its owner's hand. (You face a dilemma as you choose one or more modes for a spell or ability.)
sources.source_chinese: 当此结界进场时，目标对手可以令你抓一张牌。若其未如此作，则其失去4点生命且你刺探1。\n每当你面临两难时，你可以将此结界移回其拥有者手上。（你为咒语或异能选择一项或多项模式时，便面临两难。）

sources.source_english:
Affinity for artifact creatures
Whenever this Spacecraft enters or attacks, assimilate a creature card exiled with it. If you can't, exile up to one target creature. (To assimilate a card, put it onto the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter. It's a Borg artifact creature and loses all other creature types.)
Station
12+ | Artifact creatures you control have flying.
sources.source_chinese:
神器生物共鸣
每当此太空船进场或攻击时，同化一张以此放逐的生物牌。若你无法如此作，则放逐至多一个目标生物。（同化一张牌的流程，是将该牌在你操控下放进战场，且上面有一个+1/+1指示物。它是博格人神器生物，并失去所有其他生物类别。）
蓄势
12+ | 由你操控的神器生物具有飞行异能。

When this creature enters, choose one —
• Return target Spacecraft card from your graveyard to your hand.
• Surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
sources.source_chinese: 当此生物进场时，选择一项～\n•将目标太空船牌从你坟墓场移回你手上。\n•刺探2。（检视你牌库顶的两张牌，然后将其中任意数量置入你坟墓场，其余则以任意顺序置于你牌库顶。）
